component.name: StreamSnap
component.summary: Stream movies, series and live TV with Real-Debrid

description.p: StreamSnap is a desktop streaming app. It finds the best stream for every resolution in your language through Torrentio and Real-Debrid, plays Live TV from an Xtream Codes provider with a channel guide, and can download titles and record live channels for later.

ul.li: Automatic per-resolution stream selection in your native language
Built-in player with quality switching, captions, skip intro and credits, autoplay next episode
Live TV with a channel guide and DVR recordings
